title: The State of AI Companions 2026
discussion_signal: The post defines AI companions as systems designed to simulate or support ongoing emotional and social needs through conversation, memory, and emotional modelling. It places companionship between support and simulation, making authenticity, dependence, and the meaning of connection open research questions.
linked_research_question: What social meaning and support do people assign to AI companions, and where do simulation and relationship become difficult to distinguish?
limits: Research summary with mixed audience reactions
